official_title: Mujer en azul (Woman in Blue)
contradictions: Page says it 'went unnoticed' at the 1901 General Exhibition of Fine Arts (old: won an honourable mention); page says it was forgotten until it entered the Museo Nacional de Arte Moderno, then reached the museum in 1988 via the MEAC redistribution (old: 'rescued by an art historian'). Old omits the Velázquez Mariana of Austria source the page cites.

official_title: La tertulia del Café de Pombo (The Gathering at the Café de Pombo)
contradictions: None material. Café on Calle Carretas just off Puerta del Sol; Saturday tertulia from 1915; Gómez de la Serna standing at centre (matches). Page names 9 sitters (old: 'a dozen men'). Donated by Ramón Gómez de la Serna, 1947.

official_title: La casa de la palmera (House with Palm Tree)
contradictions: Page: a farmhouse CLOSE TO the property of Miró's parents at Mont-roig (old: 'this is the family farm'). Old's onward pointer to the 1934 painting 'a few rooms on' fails: that work has no display location (see 016).

official_title: Portrait de Madame Josette Gris (Portrait of Madame Josette Gris)
contradictions: Official title is Portrait de Madame Josette Gris (old: Retrato de Josette). Painted on board. Donation of Douglas Cooper, 1979. Page frames it via Corot/Cézanne (Madame Cézanne au fauteuil jaune) and 'flat and coloured architecture'; old's 'from abstraction back toward the object' quote not on page.

official_title: Composición cubista (Cubist Composition)
technique: Oil and collage on canvas, 154 x 114 cm
contradictions: Old WHERE YOU ARE describes 'a figure'; page describes near-abstract colour planes masking barely perceptible objects, with a baroque moulding, lemon-yellow/pink/orange/green palette - not a figure. Date 1916-1919 (old: c.1916). Associates on page: Gris, Metzinger, Lipchitz (old adds Rivera).

official_title: NOT FOUND: no Picasso Cubist still life c.1912 located on official site
contradictions: Track is generic. Nearest official Cubist Picasso on display: Tête de femme (Fernande), 1909-1910, oil on canvas 61 x 50 cm, Exhibited in Room 204.01 (https://www.museoreinasofia.es/en/collections/artwork/tete-de-femme-fernande-womans-head-fernande) - a head, not a still life; old 'Woman in Blue downstairs' is wrong (same floor).

official_title: Tête de femme (Fernande) (Woman's Head [Fernande])
contradictions: Candidate replacement for 009: Analytical Cubist head painted at Horta; browns, greens, greys, blacks.

official_title: Femme assise I (Seated Woman I) [closest iron work found]
technique: Forge and welding; iron and painted wood, 118.5 x 38 x 59 cm
contradictions: Track generic ('iron'); no González iron sculpture with an 'Exhibited in Room' line found. Also checked Personnage allongé II (c.1936, iron) - no location line. Page confirms 'drawing in space' and link to Picasso's metal period 1928-1932.

official_title: Kiki de Montparnasse / Masque d'Arlequín souriant IV / Petit masque de Pierrot [masks checked]
technique: Ormolu (lost-wax, welded) / copper sheet (welded, cut out) / patinated bronze
room_string: (no location line on any of the three pages)
contradictions: No Gargallo mask found with a display location. Other URLs: .../masque-darlequin-souriant-iv-smiling-harlequin-mask-iv ; .../petit-masque-de-pierrot-pierrots-little-mask

official_title: Visage du Grand Masturbateur (Face of the Great Masturbator)
contradictions: Official title is Visage du Grand Masturbateur (old: El gran masturbador). Page does not support: head shaped from a Cap de Creus rock; ants; slashed by a far-right group when first shown in Paris (unsupported). Page: painted late summer 1929 after Gala stayed in Cadaqués; grasshopper suckles the figure. Salvador Dalí Bequest 1990.

official_title: Figura en una finestra (Figure at the Window)
contradictions: Technique is oil on papier-mâché (old: oil on paper). Official title Catalan 'Figura en una finestra'. Not 'a few steps' from the Great Masturbator: that is in 205.13. Page cites Ingres, Picasso, Mantegna's Death of the Virgin (old cites Friedrich - not on page).

official_title: L'homme invisible (The Invisible Man)
contradictions: Not on display. Page: figure is a seated man like an Egyptian colossus revealed via anamorphic perspective; sources Arcimboldo and Joos de Momper. Page does not say unfinished.

official_title: Peinture (Escargot, femme, fleur, étoile) (Painting [Snail, Woman, Flower, Star])
contradictions: No display location. Canvas is taller than wide (195 x 172; old: 'a wide canvas'). Page: conceived as a cartoon for a tapestry commissioned by Marie Cuttoli (old omits). Donation of Pilar Juncosa, 1986.

official_title: Portrait II
contradictions: Old: 'small, fierce canvas... flaming red-and-black ground'; page: large (162 x 130), broad calm colour areas, LESS agitated than earlier work, anticipating the Constellations. Old 'beside the 1934 painting hanging ahead' fails (016 not shown).

official_title: Un mundo (A World)
contradictions: Old: she was eighteen; page quotes Gómez de la Serna on 'a seventeen-year-old girl'. Shown at Salón de Otoño, Madrid 1929 (matches). Lorca/Rimbaud comparison not on page.

official_title: La verbena (The Fair)
contradictions: None. One-eyed giant, beggar with deformed feet and guitar confirmed; one of four Verbena oils shown 1928 at Revista de Occidente, presented by Ortega y Gasset.

official_title: Le lion, la neige (The Lion, The Snow) [decalcomania]
technique: Decalcomania and gouache on paper, 20 x 25 cm
contradictions: Only decalcomania found; it is on paper, not 'a canvas', and not on display. Paysage cosmique (1938) and Composición cósmica (1938) also 'Not exhibited'. Domínguez on display: Papillons perdus dans la montagne, 1934, oil on canvas, Room 205.14 (not decalcomania).

official_title: Papillons perdus dans la montagne (Butterflies Lost in the Mountain)
contradictions: Candidate replacement for 020: father's butterfly collection, two women in Guanche-style dress on a mountain (possibly Teide).

official_title: The Enigma of Hitler
contradictions: No display location. Page: telephone receiver central motif; Breton's Surrealists expelled Dalí over Hitler. Plate, photo, Chamberlain umbrella, beach not on page. Dated 1939 (old: around 1939).

official_title: Un chien andalou
contradictions: No collection artwork page found on museoreinasofia.es; screening room location unverified.

official_title: Guernica
contradictions: ROOM WRONG: 205.10, not 206. Page: loan extended until democracy was restored (old: 'when Spain was a republic again'). Returned to Spain 1981 but entered the Reina Sofía in 1992 from the Casón del Buen Retiro (old 'it has not left since' arriving in Madrid 1981 glosses this). Dora Maar photos not on page.

official_title: Mercury Fountain (Maquette)
technique: Assemblage: plywood, paperboard, iron sheet, tin, steel wire, paint; 88 x 105.5 x 106 cm, 1:3 scale model
contradictions: ROOM WRONG: 205.09, not 206. What is shown is a 1:3 scale MAQUETTE with NO mercury (simulated in painted cardboard), not a running reconstruction behind glass. Long-term loan of Calder Foundation, New York, 2008.

official_title: La Montserrat (1937) - not in collection; related: Masque de Montserrat criant (Mask of Montserrat Screaming)
technique: Lost-wax casting, patinated [mask], 22.5 x 15.2 x 12 cm
contradictions: Mask page confirms La Montserrat original is in the Stedelijk Museum, Amsterdam; no Reina Sofía page for La Montserrat or any stand-in in the Pavilion room. Mask (Donation of Roberta González 1973) has no display location.

official_title: El segador (The Reaper)
contradictions: No collection artwork page or room found on museoreinasofia.es for the Reaper or its documentation.

official_title: Loyalist Militiaman [Capa print on display]
technique: Gelatin silver print on paper, image 29.6 x 39.8 cm
contradictions: ROOM WRONG: Capa is in 205.16, not 207. The Falling Soldier not found on the official site; 'Republican Militiamen (Córdoba Front)', Sept 1936, is 'Not exhibited'. Donation of Cornell Capa, 1998. Old's Falling Soldier focus is unsupported.

official_title: Obrers, camperols, soldats, intel.lectuals (Workers, Peasants, Soldiers, Intellectuals)
contradictions: ROOM WRONG: 205.05, not 207. Page gives only catalogue data (does not confirm Renau commissioning Guernica).
